description: Keyboard sound playback while typing in other Windows apps; 14 sound packs and a three-day trial.
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'Klakk supports per-user Scoop installation only. Omit --global.' }
if ($native -ne $expected) { throw 'Use the native architecture. Do not override Scoop architecture for this installer.' }
if ($os.CurrentMajorVersionNumber -lt 10) { throw 'Klakk requires Windows 10 or later.' }

if (@($keys | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ }).Count) { throw 'Another Klakk installation is registered. Uninstall it through its existing installation method before installing with Scoop.' }
Write-Warning 'The official Klakk 1.4.1 installer is unsigned. SHA-256 verifies the release file; it does not provide publisher signing.'
pre_uninstall: if ($entry.UninstallString.Trim('"') -ne $expected) { throw 'The registered Klakk belongs to another installation. Scoop will not uninstall it. Resolve the other installation first.' }
throw 'Klakk registration is missing. Scoop will not invoke an uninstaller with unknown ownership.'
notes: Publisher-maintained Scoop bucket; not a Scoop main/Extras catalog entry.
Website Windows edition 1.4.1: native x64 or ARM64, Windows 10/11.
The trial starts at first launch and lasts three days. Continued use is US$4.49 once for Windows plus applicable tax.
Mac website and Mac App Store purchases are separate. Settings and license data in LocalAppData\Klakk are retained on uninstall.
Launch Klakk (Scoop) from Start. Exit Klakk before Scoop update or uninstall, and use one installation method at a time.
